 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing the different types of fruits and vegetables available to consumers.
 
• The term "**varieties**" is used to describe different kinds or types of something.
 
• "**Varieties**" fits well within the context of describing the diverse options of fruits and vegetables.

The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 2 is 'varieties.'

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read** ".....****They also contain fibre. There are many varieties__ of fruits and vegetables available and many ways to prepare, cook, and serve them."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("traits", "characters", "uses") do not accurately convey the intended meaning of different types available.

 
• **Traits** (लक्षण): "Traits" refers to characteristics or features, which does not fit well in describing the different options of fruits and vegetables.
 
• **Characters** (चरित्र): "Characters" refers to qualities or personalities, which is not relevant to the context of describing varieties of fruits and vegetables.
 
• **Uses** (उपयोग): "Uses" refers to the purposes for which something is used, which does not align with the context of describing the different types of fruits and vegetables available.
